name: Fred E Cohen
current_role: Co-founder & Chairman, Monograph Capital; Co-founder & Senior Managing Director, Vida Ventures; director at Intellia, CareDx, Kyverna
profile: Physician-scientist (Yale BS, Oxford DPhil as a Rhodes Scholar, Stanford MD) who spent 1980-2014 at UCSF, including as Chief of Endocrinology and Metabolism. Co-founded TPG Biotech (2001-2016), then Vida Ventures (2017) and Monograph Capital; sits on several biotech boards.
interesting_fact: Has published 200+ peer-reviewed papers, is co-inventor on 10+ patents, and was elected to the National Academy of Medicine (2004) and American Academy of Arts and Sciences (2008).
deep_cut_fact: His UCSF research covered prion diseases and structure-based drug design, and he shared the LVMH 'Science pour l'art' prize with Nobel laureate Stanley Prusiner.
notes: Best route is via Monograph Capital's published media/info emails. Biotech investor; little energy/data-center overlap beyond computational biology.
